title: Vermicelli Bowl with Portuguese Chicken
description: A gluten-free and flavorful vermicelli bowl filled with grilled chicken, rice, and mixed vegetables.
instructions: Cook the rice according to package instructions.
Grill the chicken breast until it reaches an internal temperature of 165°F (74°C).
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped onion, bell pepper, and tomato to the skillet and cook until the vegetables are tender.
Add the portuguese seasoning blend to the skillet and stir to combine.
Add the cooked chicken to the skillet and stir to combine.
Cook the vermicelli noodles according to package instructions.
To assemble the bowls, place a portion of the cooked rice in the bottom, followed by the grilled chicken and vegetable mixture, and finally the cooked vermicelli noodles.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
